metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins for MgCohen

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Personal skills, agents and hooks that follow me everywhere

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write all output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with content rules for documents, commits, PRs and code comments.

plugins.name: unity-worktrees
plugins.description: Unity-ready worktrees for Claude Code sessions, with the Library seeded via the Unity CLI

plugins.name: agent-tools
plugins.description: One MCP server that exposes local scripts as tools, from tool.toml manifests. Scans at session start and on demand.

plugins.name: notion-context
plugins.description: Reads a Notion page and its related pages as one document. Needs the agent-tools plugin, which exposes notion_get and notion_query.

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Runs the Linear Triage intake: capture requests, fill a template for each kind of work in small steps, and route each request.
